_mailReplies: Replies to the letters the player sends by courier (systems/mail.js): weight 0 — never drawn by the daily tick; mail: true — their answers are applied by Mail.answerReply, and leaving one unanswered costs nothing but the letters marked lapseEffect.

lapse._doc: What silence costs (systems/courtLetters.js lapseCosts). Each kind's own 'lapse' block names its base cost: deed (data/lordMemory.json, remembered by the sender's lord; deedShare scales the deed's weight), reputation (in the sender's realm), renown, feud (with a rival House), affection (your spouse's), withdraw (days that sender sends no letter of that kind again: the lost offer, named by 'lost'). Every cost is scaled by who wrote: sender (by type; 'liege' is the lord you are sworn to), realm (a stronger crown's slight weighs more: its military over the world mean, square-rooted, clamped to min..max), and repeat (each letter of theirs left unanswered in the last grievanceWindow days adds repeatStep, up to repeatMax). Every grievanceAt snubs within the window the lord takes a grievance (grievanceDeed). warnDays: the inbox marks a letter urgent this close to its deadline.

office_offer.subject: An office at court
office_offer.body: {from} writes in a clerk's careful hand: the crown has need of a {title}, and your name was spoken. The seal of {realm} hangs from the ribbon.

accept.label: Accept the office of {title}
accept.tooltip: You are appointed {title}: a salary, and duties to keep.
accept.result: You take the office of {title}. {from} is pleased.

decline.label: Decline with thanks
decline.tooltip: A small slight: the lord remembers it.
decline.result: You decline the office. The reply is cool.

office_offer.ignored: No answer went back to {from} about the office of {title}. It went to another.

marriage_proposal.subject: A match for {child}
marriage_proposal.body: {from} proposes a match between {child} and a noble house of {realm}. They offer a dowry of {amount} gold, and the friendship of their crown.

accept.label: Accept the match for {child}
accept.tooltip: {child} weds into {realm}; you receive {amount} gold. Opinion rises.
accept.result: The banns are read. {child} will wed into {realm}, and {amount} gold comes with the bride-price.

refuse.label: Refuse the match
refuse.tooltip: They will take it as a slight.
refuse.result: You refuse. {from} does not hide the insult taken.

marriage_proposal.ignored: Your silence on {child}'s match was taken as a refusal in {realm}.

lapse.lost: no more invitations to that hall for a while

feast_invite.subject: An invitation to feast
feast_invite.body: {from} bids you to a feast at court: boar and venison, minstrels, and the great of {realm} at the long tables. A gift for the host is expected (about {amount} gold).

attend.label: Attend, with a gift ({amount}g)
attend.tooltip: Renown and standing in {realm}; the lord remembers you were there. You hear the court's news.
attend.result: You feast at {from}'s table, and hear much of {realm}'s affairs.

feast_invite.ignored: The feast at {from}'s court went on without you, and your empty place was noticed.

lapse.lost: the heralds stop crying your name

tournament_invite.subject: A tournament proclaimed
tournament_invite.body: Heralds of {realm} proclaim a tournament under {from}'s banner, with a purse of {prize} gold for the champion. Entry is {amount} gold.

compete.label: Ride in the lists ({amount}g)
compete.tooltip: Three bouts on the duel engine, fought on instinct. Prize, renown, bruises.

watch.label: Attend as a spectator
watch.tooltip: A little standing for being seen there.
watch.result: You watch from the stands and drink to the champion.

call_to_arms.subject: A call to arms
call_to_arms.body: {from} summons the sworn swords of {realm}: we are at war with {enemy}. Ride to the host, or send what you can.

ride.label: I will ride (fight {enemy} within {days} days)
ride.tooltip: A promise: win a campaign battle against {enemy} for your liege (Realm Politics → Campaign) within {days} days, or break your word.
ride.result: You swear to ride against {enemy}. {from} will be watching.

gold.label: Send gold instead ({amount}g)
gold.tooltip: The gold goes to your liege's war chest.
gold.result: Your gold goes to the war chest of {realm}.

refuse.label: Refuse the summons
refuse.result: You refuse the summons. It will be remembered.

call_to_arms.ignored: You never answered {from}'s call to arms. Your silence was louder than a refusal.

loan_request.subject: A request for a loan
loan_request.body: {from} writes, not without embarrassment, that the treasury of {realm} is pressed. Would you lend {amount} gold, to be repaid with {interest} in {days} days?

lend.label: Lend {amount} gold
lend.tooltip: Repaid with {interest} interest in {days} days — if the crown can and will. Opinion rises.

loan_request.ignored: {from}'s letter asking for a loan went unanswered.

loan_default.subject: The debt of {realm}
loan_default.body: {from} writes that the crown cannot repay the {amount} gold it owes you, and begs your patience.

forgive.label: Forgive the debt
forgive.tooltip: The gold is gone, but the lord will not forget the kindness.
forgive.result: You forgive the debt. {from} is moved.

demand.label: Demand what you are owed
demand.tooltip: Perhaps half comes back, if the treasury has it. The lord resents it.

loan_default.ignored: The debt of {realm} is written off in silence.

rival_truce.subject: {from} offers a truce
rival_truce.body: A sealed letter from {from}: the quarrel between your Houses has cost both too much. They propose a truce.

accept.label: Accept the truce
accept.result: You accept {from}'s truce. The feud cools.

rival_truce.ignored: {from}'s offer of truce went unanswered, and the feud festers.

rival_tribute.subject: {from} demands tribute
rival_tribute.body: {from} demands {amount} gold as the price of leaving your House in peace.

pay.label: Pay {amount} gold
pay.result: You pay. {from} is satisfied, for now.

insult.label: Send back an insult
insult.tooltip: Renown for your defiance, but the feud runs hot.
insult.result: Your reply is copied and laughed over in every tavern. {from} is not laughing.

rival_tribute.ignored: You ignored {from}'s demand. They take it as defiance.

lapse.lost: the match is not offered again

rival_marriage.subject: {from} proposes a match to end the feud
rival_marriage.body: {from} proposes that {child} wed into their House, and the feud between you be buried at the altar.

accept.label: Wed {child} to end the feud
accept.tooltip: {child} marries into {realm}; the feud cools by {feudCut}.
accept.result: {child} weds into {from}. The feud is buried at the altar.

rival_marriage.ignored: {from}'s offer of a match went unanswered.

spouse_plea.subject: {from} pleads for {realm}
spouse_plea.body: {from} cannot sleep. Your realm is at war with {realm}, where {from} was born. "Speak for peace, I beg you. Those are my people."

plead.label: Speak for peace at court
plead.tooltip: Your liege thinks less of you; {realm} thinks more; the crowns' relations warm. {from} is grateful.
plead.result: You speak for peace. {from} weeps with relief.

terms.label: Offer {realm} terms ({amount}g)
terms.result: You buy peace with {realm}. {from} embraces you.

duty.label: Duty comes first
duty.result: You tell {from} that duty comes first. The silence is cold.

spouse_plea.ignored: You never answered {from}'s plea. It is not forgotten at home.

gift.label: Send love and a gift ({amount}g)
gift.tooltip: The court of {realm} thinks better of your House.
gift.result: Your gift goes to {child}'s household in {realm}.

intel.label: Ask what is said at court
intel.tooltip: Learn of {realm}'s ruler, army and treasury.
intel.result: {child} writes back what is said at court.

family_report._doc: Sent by systems/heirAgency.js and systems/regency.js: a child's or regent's account of a commission, a fosterage, a battle (weight 0: never drawn by the daily tick). Replying warms the realm named, if any; silence costs nothing.
family_report.subject: {subject}

reply.label: Write back
reply.tooltip: A few lines in your own hand.

child_hostage.subject: {child} is afraid
child_hostage.body: {child} writes from {realm}: now that our realms are at war, the court looks at me as a hostage. Bring me home, or trust my spouse's kin to keep me safe.

recall.label: Bring {child} home ({amount}g)
recall.tooltip: Bribes and an escort. {realm}'s crown takes it as an insult.

trust.label: Trust the kin of {child}'s spouse
trust.tooltip: The crown of {realm} appreciates it — but if it thinks ill of you, {child} may be held.
trust.result: You write that you trust {realm}'s honour.

coalition_ultimatum._doc: Sent by systems/coalitions.js when a league is sworn against the player (weight 0: never drawn by the daily tick). Its answers call Coalitions.concede / Coalitions.defy; left unanswered, the league marches on its own deadline.
coalition_ultimatum.subject: The terms of {league}
coalition_ultimatum.body: {from} writes in the name of {league} — {members}. {cause} Pay {amount} gold to the league's war chest, or bow before its courts ({prestige} Prestige), within {days} days. Otherwise every crown of the league will march.

concede.label: Pay the league {amount} gold
concede.tooltip: The league stands down. Its members are paid; the courts see you bend (a little Prestige).

bow.label: Bow before the league ({prestige} Prestige)
bow.tooltip: The league stands down; your House's Prestige pays for it.

defy.label: Throw their terms back
defy.tooltip: War from every crown of the league, at once. Their lords remember the insult.
defy.result: You send the envoys home with nothing. {league} marches.

coalition_ultimatum.ignored: No answer went to {league}. It marches.

file.label: File the letter
file.result: You file {from}'s letter with your papers.

mail_proposal.subject: {subject}

decline.label: Let it rest
decline.tooltip: Nothing is sealed; {from} is a little disappointed.

mail_proposal.ignored: {from}'s answer to your proposal went unanswered, and the moment passed.

pay.label: Pay {amount}g for {child}
pay.tooltip: {child} comes home; the gold goes to the crown of {realm}.
pay.result: The ransom is paid. {child} is on the road home.

refuse.label: Refuse the price
refuse.tooltip: {child} stays at {realm}'s court. You may write again.

mail_request._doc: A correspondent in want asks for food or the coin to buy it (systems/mail.js _hooks: their market short of a food good). Goods go into their town's market, coin to their purse or their town's; their goodwill rises and the town talks of it (Gossip famine_dole). Refused or ignored, a little goodwill is lost.
mail_request.subject: {subject}

goods.label: Send {qty} {good}
goods.tooltip: From your packs, into {town}'s market. {from} will not forget it.

coin.label: Send {gold} gold
coin.tooltip: Coin to buy what they need. {from} will not forget it.

refuse.label: Write that you cannot
refuse.tooltip: {from} thinks a little less of you.
refuse.result: You write that you cannot help.

mail_invite._doc: A correspondent asks the player to visit their town by a deadline (systems/mail.js _hooks). A promise is kept by standing in the town in time (goodwill), or broken (a little lost); regrets cost nothing.
mail_invite.subject: {subject}

promise.label: Promise to come to {town} by {deadline}
promise.tooltip: Be in {town} by day {until}: {from} will be glad of it. Miss it and they will remember.

mail_blackmail.subject: Your letter to {lover}
mail_blackmail.body: An unsigned hand writes: your letter to {lover} passed through my hands before it reached them. {amount} gold left at the post house buys my silence. Otherwise, your spouse and the whole town will read it.

pay.label: Pay {amount}g for silence
pay.tooltip: The letter is burnt, they say.
pay.result: You pay. The matter goes quiet.

refuse.label: Refuse
refuse.tooltip: The letter will be read aloud: a scandal, and your spouse's anger.

mail_blackmail.ignored: You never paid, and the letter was read aloud in the market.

courier_bag.subject: A sealed letter in your rider's bag
courier_bag.body: One of your riders at {courier} carries a letter under the seal of {lordName} of {realm}, bound for {dest}. The seal could be lifted and set again. Nobody would know, probably.

deliver.label: Deliver it sealed
deliver.result: The letter is delivered with its seal unbroken.

read.label: Read it first
read.tooltip: Learn {realm}'s affairs. If it comes out, your house and you are disgraced.
read.result: You lift the seal by candlelight.

sell.label: Sell it to {enemy} ({price}g)
sell.tooltip: Gold, and {enemy}'s gratitude. If it comes out, a scandal and {lordName}'s enmity.
sell.result: The letter is copied for {enemy}'s agents.

courier_bag.ignored: The rider delivered the letter sealed, as nobody told him otherwise.

stolen_mailbag.subject: A sealed letter in a stolen mailbag
stolen_mailbag.body: Among the {letters} letters in the bag you took from the rider of {courier} is one under the seal of {lordName} of {realm}, bound for {dest}. Nobody knows yet where it went.

burn.label: Burn it
burn.tooltip: No one will ever read it — or know you had it.

read.label: Read it
read.tooltip: Learn {realm}'s affairs. If it comes out, {lordName} will not forget whose hands it passed through.
read.result: You break the seal by candlelight.

sell.label: Sell it to {enemy} ({price}g)
sell.tooltip: Gold, and {enemy}'s gratitude. If it comes out, a scandal and {lordName}'s enmity.

stolen_mailbag.ignored: The letter rots in your saddlebag, unread.
